paras: Lerista wilkinsi, also known commonly as the two-toed fine-lined slider and Wilkins' lerista,  is a species of skink, a lizard in the family Scincidae. The species is endemic to Queensland in Australia.
The specific name, wilkinsi, is in honour of Australian explorer George Hubert Wilkins.
The preferred natural habitats of L. wilkinsi are forest and savanna.
